messages:
mira (CS): quick heads-up — i'm finishing a customer-facing 'heartbeat' one-pager for renewal-risk mitigation. aim: 15-min enablement call + 1-page checklist (cache/batch/stream) + telemetry keys. drafting script below, need quick review.

devon (ENG): lgtm. want a short config snippet? our defaults for small-to-mid tenants: cache TTL 30s, max_batch 16, batch timeout 8ms, streaming enabled. paste coming.

devon (ENG): ```
# recommended runtime snippet for field ops
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_ttl_ms: 30000
batching:
  max_batch_size: 16
  timeout_ms: 8
streaming: true
# note: tune max_batch_size down for latency-sensitive flows
```

sam (CS Ops): love the defaults. add a pre-warm step for go-live: run 100 synthetic requests using the customer's top 5 prompts at ~5 qps for 2 minutes to populate prefix cache. also capture these telemetry keys during the run: lat_p50, lat_p95, tokens_per_request, cache_hit_rate, error_rate.

ana (DE): tiny UX request — put a 1-line decision tree at the top of the one-pager: "cache_hit_rate < 20% -> enable client prefill; tokens_per_request > 300 -> consider quantized model or smaller context." keeps it actionable for PMs. :+1:

mira (CS): thanks — i'll fold those in. draft 15-min call script (feel free to edit):
1) 0:00-1:30 — quick intro + goal (reduce laggy sessions, improve cost predictability)
2) 1:30-6:00 — run live demo (show 2 requests: cold vs warmed cache)
3) 6:00-10:00 — review recommended runtime snippet + pre-warm routine
4) 10:00-13:30 — examine telemetry from warm run and identify risks (low cache_hit_rate, spike in tokens)
5) 13:30-15:00 — agree next steps and handoff to eng for follow-up A/B.

mira (CS): also adding a tiny troubleshooting table: "If p95 > 800ms -> reduce batch window or enable streaming; if cache_hit_rate < 10% -> check prompt variability + client-side prefill; sustained errors -> capture sample ids and escalate to eng oncall."

ops-bot: reminder — please attach the last 10 warm-run traces to the tenant ticket before the call.

devon (ENG): ack. i'll add a one-liner about safe rollback: set routing policy to fallback-model=smaller-quantized for 24h, and we can revert after telemetry stabilizes.

mira (CS): perfect. i'll update the one-pager and share a PDF for review before our Thu sync. thanks all.
